description: This file defines the DownloadManagerImplementation class, which implements the IDownloadManager interface for managing downloads, including configuration, download info, and download control methods.

classes.name: DownloadManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IDownloadManager interface, manages download queue, configuration, and download operations.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles JSON configuration for download directory and ID.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Stores information about individual downloads, including URL, ID, retries, priority, and cancellation status.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts a download with specified URL and options.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the download manager with the service.

methods.name: downloaderRoutine
methods.description: Background thread routine for managing downloads.

methods.name: pickDownloadJob
methods.description: Selects the next download job from the queue.

methods.name: nextRetryDuration
methods.description: Calculates delay before next retry using golden ratio.

methods.name: getDownloadReason
methods.description: Converts download reason enum to string.
